title: Leaked cloud-store environment sent a test suite at production storage
severity: irreversible contamination of a locked retention bucket; no data loss; no clinical data involved

timeline_utc.event: audit epoch bucket locked, seven-year retention
check_locked_epoch_gate.py verified the bucket EMPTY; zero objects written
operator set WOUNDAI_STORE=gcs, WOUNDAI_GCS_BUCKET, WOUNDAI_GCS_PREFIX, WOUNDAI_AUDIT_BUCKET in the shell for that gate check; no teardown was given
run_python_tests.py executed in the same shell; env inherited
first contaminating write: seq 0, actor default:t_admin, action user_upsert_intent, code default:ns09, prev GENESIS
second run (pristine origin/main control worktree) added further writes
root cause identified; environment variables cleared; no further writes

locked_audit_epoch.content: well-formed chain_v=4 audit slots written by test fixtures; seq 0 occupies prev=GENESIS
locked_audit_epoch.deletable_reason: locked seven-year retention policy; objects cannot be removed or overwritten until 2033
locked_audit_epoch.consequence: this bucket can no longer serve as the formal clean audit epoch

legacy_audit_bucket.note: not referenced by any leaked variable; unchanged; still must not be locked

root_cause_layers: tools/windows/run_python_tests.py built the child environment with os.environ.copy() and did not remove cloud-store variables
the backend could not tell it was running inside a test process; get_store() asked only whether the audit bucket was a locked seven-year epoch, which it was
isolation depended on each test file remembering os.environ.pop('WOUNDAI_STORE'); all 12 tests that reached production storage lacked it, while every test that had it passed

evidence_of_causation.method: identical suite run on the contaminated environment against the branch and against a pristine origin/main worktree, then again after clearing the variables
evidence_of_causation.clean_environment_after_fix: 60/60 passed, 0 failed, 82.7s (from 404s: the failures were network round-trips to GCS)

remediation.layer_1: run_python_tests.py strips WOUNDAI_STORE, WOUNDAI_GCS_*, WOUNDAI_AUDIT_BUCKET before spawning any test
remediation.layer_2: store.get_store() raises when WOUNDAI_STORE=gcs and WOUNDAI_REQUIRE_FUNCTIONAL_TESTS=1; it refuses rather than silently falling back to local, which would hand out a false green
remediation.layer_3: engineering/phase2/test_test_isolation_from_cloud.py pins both layers, including a subprocess that proves a test process cannot construct a GcsStore, plus negative controls proving real GCS use and LocalStore are unaffected

decisions.epoch_bucket: abandoned; a new epoch bucket will be created for the formal start
decisions.new_epoch_must_not_be_locked_early: Locking an empty bucket was documented as a technical step with no data implications. That was wrong: a locked bucket can be contaminated but never cleaned, so locking early converts a same-day mistake into a seven-year liability. The new epoch bucket stays unlocked until real collection begins -- which also makes it immune to this failure mode, since require_locked_audit_epoch() refuses to write to an unlocked bucket.

does_not_establish: any change to the three earlier evidence records, which are left untouched
